sources.title: Abandoned campfire caused Yosemite Dome Fire that killed two pilots
sources.quote: The Dome Fire that has burned over 5,000 acres and caused the deaths of two pilots in Yosemite National Park was caused by an abandoned campfire, according to fire crews at the scene.
